an4.158:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
an4.158:1.3: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an4.158:2.1: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ--
an4.158:2.5: Rāgavepullataṃ, dosavepullataṃ, mohavepullataṃ, gambhīresu kho pan' assa ṭhānaṭṭhānesu paññācakkhuṃ na kamati.
an4.158:2.6: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ
an4.158:3.1: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ--
an4.158:3.5: Rāgatanuttaṃ, dosatanuttaṃ, mohatanuttaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan' assa ṭhānaṭṭhānesu paññācakkhuṃ kamati.
an4.158:3.6: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ
